en.headline: PolyU Design students show speculative furniture for future Hong Kong at free Tsim Sha…
en.dek: The Henceforth… Hong Kong… show at The Grid in Heath Mall runs until 24 November, with touchable pieces and selected VR sessions exploring density and ageing.
body: Students from the Hong Kong Polytechnic University School of Design are presenting nine speculative furniture pieces that respond to possible future conditions in Hong Kong, including high density, an ageing population and resource constraints.

The exhibition, titled Henceforth… Hong Kong… — Physical Furniture × Virtual Futures, is open daily from 11am to 9pm until 24 November at The Grid, Heath Mall, B/F, 36-44 Nathan Road in Tsim Sha Tsui. Admission is free and no registration is required. Visitors are invited to touch the materials and sit on the works; selected sessions include VR views from the furniture’s perspective.

Each piece carries two dates: the year it was made and a future year for which it was designed. The show is organised by PolyU Design with the Hong Kong Furniture and Decoration Trade Association, and forms part of the wider Design@HKG programme.

zh.headline: 理大設計學生尖沙咀免費展覽展出未來香港推測家具
zh.dek: 《今後…香港…》在慶方The Grid展出至11月24日，參觀者可觸摸及試坐，指定時段有VR體驗。
body: 香港理工大學設計學院學生展出九件推測家具，回應香港可能面對的高密度、人口老化及資源限制等未來情況。
展覽名為《今後…香港…——實體家具 × 虛擬未來》，每日上午11時至晚上9時在尖沙咀彌敦道36-44號慶方地庫The Grid舉行，至11月24日。免費入場，毋須預約。參觀者可觸摸物料及試坐作品；指定時段設有從家具視角觀看未來情景的VR體驗。
每件作品標有兩個年份：製作年份及設計所針對的未來年份。展覽由理大設計學院主辦，並與香港傢係裝飾業總會合作，屬設計@HKG活動一部分。
